== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Dack Ralter (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Dack Ralter (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 24 January 2018). The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>645b989b5c42ee3c1e750c680b7fc2d901242530</code>.
